title: 1968 “Mother of All Demos” by SRI’s Doug Engelbart and Team
summary: Highlights from Doug Engelbart's December 1968 demonstration at SRI, the first public showing of the mouse, hypertext, windows, real-time collaborative editing and shared-screen teleconferencing. This is a roughly six-minute condensed version of the full demo.
why: HN uses it as the go-to reference for how many modern computing ideas, collaboration included, were demonstrated in 1968.

quote.text: 52 years ago, people could edit content simultaneously, actually.
